messages:
zoe: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need to close comms + decide RCA-sharing flow. Items: final statuspage sentence, 72h customer note, and whether we provide full RCAs to customers or redacted summaries.

dario: I can draft the statuspage line. Draft: "Intermittent elevated latency for Text-Gen API from 02:18-02:52 UTC caused by KV cache eviction during a model rollout. Rollback and throttling applied. No customer data exposed. Full postmortem to follow."

anya: That reads ok. Legal + security need to confirm the "No customer data exposed" claim. Also suggest adding a one-sentence mitigation note: what we did to stop it.

legal-ops: Legal: we prefer a redacted public summary. Full technical RCAs may be shared with enterprise customers under NDA/DPA. Post a redaction checklist here and we'll review within 24h.

sec-bot: Security scan: no evidence of exfiltration. Signed off on the data sentence.

ops-team: ProdOps can push statuspage once copy is posted to #statuspage-drafts. Please tag us.

eng-runtime: Recurring pattern noted: similar cache-evictions earlier this quarter. We'll own a guardrail ticket to add rollout throttles and eviction safeguards. Ticket RUNTIME-1201 created, P1.

sales-sig: For enterprise outreach we need the affected-account export. I'll coordinate after the 72h note is ready.

zoe: Action items + due ts:
- Dario: post final statuspage sentence to #statuspage-drafts and tag ProdOps (due 2405001250)
- Anya: draft 72h customer summary (TL;DR, timeline, metrics, FAQ) and post here for review by Legal/Security (due 2405001265)
- Legal-ops: publish redaction checklist for public copy (due 2405001255)
- Eng-runtime (RUNTIME-1201): implement guardrail ticket and estimate (due 2405001280)
- Sales-sig: prepare affected-account list for outreach (due 2405001270)

ops-team: We'll push immediately after copy is in #statuspage-drafts.

anya: I'll review Dario's copy and add the mitigation sentence.

zoe: Thanks all  react with :white_check_mark: when done. Closing this thread once all actions are green.
